metadata.title: Maximal ranks of free abelian subgroups of generalized cactus groups associated with finite Coxeter systems
metadata.abstract: We determine the maximum ranks of free abelian subgroups of generalized cactus groups associated with finite Coxeter systems. To obtain the upper bounds, we use the cubical flat torus theorem of Wise and Woodhouse. We then verify the sharpness of these upper bounds by constructing free abelian subgroups of the corresponding ranks. Our result shows that the maximal ranks of free abelian subgroups of ordinary cactus groups can be larger than conjectured by Genevois. As an application, we show that these groups are not quasi-isometric to any right-angled Artin group unless they are virtually free abelian.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 确定有限 Coxeter 系统对应广义 cactus 群中自由阿贝尔子群的最大秩，利用立方平坦环面定理给上界并显式实现，进而排除多数情形与 RAAG 的拟等距。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出比已有猜想更大的普通 cactus 群交换秩，并确认最优性。
analysis.limitations: 拟等距排除有虚自由阿贝尔例外；结论针对有限 Coxeter 系统。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 用于语言编辑和表述改进，未披露模型参与最大秩构造。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 用于语言编辑和表述改进，未披露模型参与最大秩构造。
